examples.text: Certains alchimistes se vantaient d’avoir trouvé des moyens pour rajeunir ou immortaliser le corps.

glosses: Rendre immortel dans la mémoire collective.

examples.text: C’est la fontaine que M. de Florian a immortalisée, en faisant passer sur ses bords la première scène de son roman de Claudine.
Victor prit son téléphone, shoota quelques objets, son canapé, sa psyché, son tapis de course et, depuis son balcon en saillie, il immortalisa la ville repoussant la lumière qui l’orangeait.
Mais cette sonate née d’un songe luciférien, qui serait immortalisé par Goethe, avait le génie de certaines forces du mal.
The meek intelligence of thoſe dear eyes / (Bleſt be the art that can immortalize, / The art that baffles time's tyrannic claim / To quench it) here ſhines on me ſtill the ſame.

glosses: To remove the effects of normal apoptosis.
To give unending life to, to make immortal.

examples.text: The meek intelligence of thoſe dear eyes / (Bleſt be the art that can immortalize, / The art that baffles time's tyrannic claim / To quench it) here ſhines on me ſtill the ſame.
His heroic deeds were immortalised in song and tale.

There is a local rhyme which says:
Culbone, Oare and Stoke Pero
Are three such places as you seldom hear o'.
Stoke Pero and Culbone are equally remote hamlets, respectively 5 miles south-east and 2½ miles east of Oare, a village of which few would have heard had not Blackmore [(R. D. Blackmore)] immortalised it.
The clocks at either end of the stadium had just ticked past 92 minutes when Branislav Ivanovic made the run that will immortalise him in Chelsea's history.
A ideia da empresária Lilian Gonçalves é imortalizar artistas conhecidos fora do País.
